nominal_scale.axis: representative mouth and channel patch width
nominal_scale.kind: nominal art-direction choice, not a newly measured fossil dimension; display scaling separately labeled

budget_intent.policy: 14k triangles and 1,000,000 bytes are ceilings, not targets. Usually aim about 100–500 KB; below this range is fine. Spend more triangles only for visible silhouette/proportion/connection benefit. Do not pad counts or enlarge textures for apparent refinement. Preserve quality if a justified asset exceeds the usual range within the hard caps.

start_gate: Next round is planning only; parent explicit exclusive assignment needed. For already assigned workers, latest state and explicit parent dispatch override stale empty claims or initial queue snapshots.
concurrency: Parent-coordinated shared host pool; default one worker x two Blender threads, no per-batch full-host allocation.

geometry_choices.en: Original nominal3m representative karst spring rock-and-bed patch: a low real cavity beneath a thick continuous rock roof opens directly into a short exposed channel in the attached bed. Geometric cavity, wall thickness and bed connection remain visible without water or blue shading; no water, lights or flow simulation exported. Layout, crop and scale are artistic, not a measured spring, hydrological rate, named site or exact age.
geometry_choices.zh: 原创名义3米岩溶泉口岩床裁片：厚实连续岩顶下低矮真实洞腔直接通向相接床面的短明渠。无水蓝色也可见洞腔壁厚及床面连接，不导出水灯或流动模拟。布局裁片与尺度属美术，非实测泉流地点年代。

cavity_floor_connection: Gallery centerline raised0.05 authored units and entire channel cross-section smoothly blended into the inner gallery floor; final bed edge lies0.002 below real floor to avoid a sill/coincident faces.
junction_topology: Exact boolean union after outward-normal checks removes overlapping roof/bed interior surfaces; final single closed connected rock volume.
